name: Monopulse
description: 开发抗电子战无人机系统的国防科技公司，结合航空航天工程、传感器融合、计算机视觉和AI技术，使无人机在信号干扰环境下保持通信或自主运行，产品包括Falcon MK3S无人机平台和Hydrohex水上监视系统
description_en: Defencetech company developing electronic warfare-resistant drone systems combining aerospace engineering, sensor fusion, computer vision and AI to enable drones to maintain communications or operate autonomously when signals are disrupted. Products include Falcon MK3S drone platform and Hydrohex water-based surveillance system
why_matters: 已为立陶宛和丹麦武装部队供货，在电子战环境下的无人机抗干扰能力填补北约军事需求空白，自主研发核心硬件和软件能力，14人团队包含工程师、研究人员和前军事人员
why_matters_en: Already supplying Lithuanian and Danish armed forces, filling NATO military needs for drone resilience in electronic warfare environments with in-house developed core hardware and software capabilities by a 14-member team including engineers, researchers and former military personnel
latest_news: 2026年10月完成超200万欧元融资，由立陶宛和国际投资者参与，包括Coinvest Capital、Plug and Play和NGL Ventures，将用于扩大生产、加速研发并进入斯堪的纳维亚等北约市场
latest_news_en: Raised over €2M in October 2026 from Lithuanian and international investors including Coinvest Capital, Plug and Play, and NGL Ventures, to expand production, accelerate R&D, and enter Scandinavian and other NATO markets
source_title: Monopulse raises over €2M to advance electronic warfare-resistant drones

evidence.quote: has raised over €2 million from investors in Lithuania and abroad. Investors included Coinvest Capital, Plug and Play, and NGL Ventures
Its technology focuses on making drones more reliable in electronic warfare environments, where communications and navigation signals can be disrupted or jammed

name: Blueprints AI
description: 使用人工智能从2D草图或PDF生成符合规范且可获得许可的建筑施工蓝图,涵盖建筑、结构、机械、电气、管道和室内设计的完整文档
description_en: Uses AI to produce code-compliant and permit-ready architectural construction blueprints in minutes from a 2D sketch or PDF, covering architecture, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and interior design documentation
why_matters: 将建筑师80%的重复制图工作时间减少到20%,让专业人员有更多时间专注于设计创新,第二代软件支持用户从描述或草图开始设计整个建筑项目,任何设计变更会自动更新整个项目并对照当地建筑规范进行检查
why_matters_en: Flips architects' time allocation from 80% drafting to 80% design by automating repetitive work; second-generation software allows users to design and make changes to entire building projects from descriptions or sketches, with automatic code compliance checking and project-wide updates
latest_news: 2026年10月在TechCrunch Disrupt发布功能更强大的第二代软件,入选2026 Startup Battlefield 200,第二代软件已向早期客户开放并将于本周公开发布
latest_news_en: Unveiling second-generation software at TechCrunch Disrupt October 2026, selected for 2026 Startup Battlefield 200, early customers already using version 2 with public availability this week
source_title: This AI startup says it can generate permit-ready blueprints in minutes

evidence.quote: Customers can start with a description or sketch of a project and create blueprints for every aspect of a building at once, including architecture, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and interior design. Version 2 allows users to design and make changes to the project, an upgrade over the first iteration. Importantly, one design change updates the entire project and is checked against local building codes.

Dram earned his bachelor's and master's degrees in architecture from the University of Tehran and completed two years of PhD coursework on digital design at the European Graduate School in Switzerland. He moved to the United States and opened an architecture firm in 2018 called Drams Design-Build. Then, after obtaining a general contractor's license, he added a construction business in 2021.

latest_news_en: Raised $5.2 million pre-Series A in H1 2026, one of the few significant healthtech deals during a period when the sector captured only $18 million across 31 rounds
source_title: Is African Healthtech Facing a Terminal Diagnosis? - Launch Base Africa

evidence.quote: led by AI Diagnostics' $5.2 million pre-Series A
AI Diagnostics has screened more than 1,000 patients in South Africa and is conducting clinical research across more than 10 countries.

name: DataGrail
description: 企业个人信息开示和删除请求管理平台,连接2500多个应用程序,自动化处理个人信息所在位置确认、请求受理、响应记录等合规流程
description_en: Enterprise platform for managing personal information disclosure and deletion requests, integrating with 2,500+ applications to automate location confirmation, request intake, and compliance response tracking
why_matters: 个人信息删除请求自2021年以来增长567%,企业面临跨多系统核查和合规压力。DataGrail通过连接2500多个应用实现自动化管理,解决了企业在隐私合规方面的实际痛点
why_matters_en: Personal information deletion requests increased 567% since 2021, creating cross-system verification and compliance pressure for enterprises. DataGrail automates management across 2,500+ applications, addressing real pain points in privacy compliance
latest_news: 2026年5月27日发布的调查显示,基于客户数据的删除相关请求自2021年增长567%
latest_news_en: Survey published May 27, 2026 shows deletion-related requests increased 567% since 2021 based on customer data
source_title: 世界の新ニッチビジネス10選 WORLD BUSINESS RADAR

evidence.quote: 2026年5月27日に発表した調査では、同社の顧客データに基づく削除関連請求が2021年から567％増加したと報告しています
